text:
sam: alerting oncall 1: spikes in 429/503 on embeddings.v1 and rerank.v2 starting ~04:47 UTC. noticed large tail latency and queue depth on embeddings pool. customers affected: beta-search (free tier) and gamma-retail (premium). tagging ops.

incident-bot: New incident INC-2416-02 created (auto). severity=P1. linked runbook /runbooks/endpoint-throttling. rota shows nina as current oncall.

nina: I'm oncall. thanks sam. quick snapshot: embeddings 5m error=26%, rerank 18%, chat normal. top callers: gamma-retail (premium traffic surge 40% of QPS), internal-batch-reindex (heavy on rerank). full top-list in metrics link.

raj: hypothesis: a scheduled bulk reindex kicked off from internal pipeline that flooded rerank path and caused downstream embedding cache misses, increasing compute and I/O. plan: immediate per-route shaping + suspend noncritical background jobs.

cleo: suggestions: 1) set hard route limit rerank.v2 for free tenants to 50rps (was 300) 2) raise embeddings.v1 burst for premium tenants to 2000 tokens/min for 30m 3) disable "async-rerank-worker" queue consumers for 10m 4) add priority header handler to deprioritize requests with X-traffic:bulk.

nina: I'll do the rerank free-tier cap and disable the async worker. raj can you handle embeddings quota bump? cleo will add routing rule.

nina: applying rerank cap via admin API: 
```
POST https://console.redwood.ai/admin/limits
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN
Content-Type: application/json

{"route":"rerank.v2","scope":"free","limit_rps":50,"note":"emergency cap for incident INC-2416-02"}
```

incident-bot: change recorded chg-2416-05 by nina at 2416005880.

cleo: adding request header rule to route low-priority batches to slow-path (202 + Retry-After): 
```
rule: if header X-traffic == "bulk" then route->slow-queue; response=202; retry-after=60
```
deployed via console at 2416006000.

raj: bumping embeddings quota for premium tenants (tenant-scope=premium) using CLI: 
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/admin/quotas" \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"route":"embeddings.v1","scope":"premium","burst_tokens_per_min":2000,"ttl":"30m","note":"temp mitigation for INC-2416-02"}'
```
Change chg-2416-07 recorded at 2416006105.

nina: disabling async-rerank-worker: 
```
kubectl scale deployment async-rerank-worker --replicas=0 -n inference
```
Executed 2416006150. documented in incident log.

incident-bot: mitigation steps applied. monitoring windows: 15m.

sam: initial impact summary for support: beta-search (free) saw 70% 429s, many timeouts; gamma-retail (premium) saw degraded latency but most requests succeeded. support notified and customer comms draft in #customer-success.

cleo: metrics update: rerank 1m-error dropped to 6% within 2m after free-tier cap. embeddings errors for premium dropped from 26% -> 8% after quota bump. overall cluster CPU normalized.

nina: rolling handoff note: I'll remain for 30m then hand to lena. lena pls watch: embeddings error >10% for 5m OR rerank error >8% for 5m triggers escalation back to SRE lead. rollback plan: revert rerank cap (chg-2416-05) and reduce premium burst (chg-2416-07) to previous values.

lena: acknowledged. will monitor dashboards and page if conditions hit. logging short summary to incident doc and linking runbook /runbooks/endpoint-throttling. :eyes:

sam: small follow-ups: 1) add a postmortem stub with suspected cause = internal batch job not rate-limited 2) consider adjusting default per-tenant quotas for rerank routes 3) schedule post-incident meeting with infra and ML infra.

nina: agreed. will create postmortem ticket INC-2416-02-PM and assign owners. keeping channel brief unless further changes.
